title: No false urgency or false scarcity
source: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 item 1 (False Urgency); CPA 2019 s.2(47); see also ASCI deceptive-design Guideline 3 (advertiser must substantiate stock level behind scarcity claims)
violation: Countdown/deadline computed client-side from now() or reset on reload/session (e.g. Date.now()+15*60*1000 stored nowhere server-side); stock or 'N people viewing' values from Math.random, hard-coded constants, or a fixed floor not tied to inventory/analytics data.
compliant: Timers read a real server-side offer end date; stock and popularity counts are read from inventory/analytics APIs, or not shown at all.
notApplicableWhen: Platform shows no timers, stock levels, popularity or scarcity messages.

title: No items, services, donations or charges added to the basket without consent
source: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 item 2 (Basket Sneaking), incl. proviso for free samples, complimentary services and disclosed necessary fees
violation: Cart/checkout state initialised with a paid add-on, insurance, membership, tip or donation selected (checked, defaultChecked, useState(true), selected: true, default quantity 1); server adds a paid line item the user did not select.
compliant: Every paid optional line starts unselected and is added only on an explicit user action. Free samples, complimentary services and necessary fees disclosed at purchase (delivery, gift wrap, taxes) are allowed.
notApplicableWhen: Checkout has no optional paid extras, donations, tips or memberships.

title: No confirm shaming in decline or opt-out copy
source: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 item 3 (Confirm Shaming)
violation: Decline/close/skip strings that shame or frighten, e.g. 'No, I will take the risk', 'Accept Risk', 'I will stay unsecured', 'No thanks, I don't care about my family', or emotional appeals (children's education, health) shown next to the option to remove a donation.
compliant: Neutral, symmetric labels such as 'No, I will not add this' / 'Add insurance'; no fear or guilt messaging attached to the decline path.
notApplicableWhen: Never applicable as a whole; the agent only marks it N/A if the platform has no upsell, renewal, donation or opt-out prompts at all.

title: No forced action to get the intended product
source: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 item 4 (Forced Action)
violation: Route guards or form validation that require login, phone number, email, app download, newsletter sign-up, membership or an extra item before the user can access or buy the item they wanted, when the item does not need it (e.g. 'free' content gated behind required phone field).
compliant: Only data and steps strictly needed for the purchase or service are required; optional sign-ups are separate, optional and skippable.
notApplicableWhen: Never fully N/A; only if the platform has no purchase, sign-up or gated content flows.

title: Cancelling a subscription is simple, visible and clear
source: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 item 5 (Subscription Trap), sub-items (i) to (iv)
violation: No cancel route or button in account/settings code; cancel only via email/phone/chat; cancel flow has more steps than sign-up (retention modals, surveys, 'are you sure' chains); cancel link hidden (tiny, low-contrast, nested menus); a free plan or trial that requires card or auto-debit authorisation; ambiguous cancel instructions.
compliant: A clearly labelled 'Cancel subscription' control reachable from account settings, completed in no more steps than sign-up, with at most one optional retention offer and a clear confirmation; free tiers need no payment details.
notApplicableWhen: Platform sells no subscriptions, memberships or recurring plans.

title: No interface interference that highlights one choice and hides another
source: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 item 6 (Interface Interference)
violation: Accept/upsell styled as a large primary button while decline is a small grey text link; fees or key terms in low-contrast or tiny fine print; a close 'X' that triggers accept, navigation or an ad; colour-coded or asymmetric sliders steering to higher amounts.
compliant: Choices with comparable consequences get comparable visual weight; key price and terms are shown at readable size and contrast; close icons only close.
notApplicableWhen: Never N/A for a platform with any user-facing choice screen.

title: No bait and switch
source: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 item 7 (Bait and Switch)
violation: Advertised price/variant/SKU replaced at add-to-cart or checkout (e.g. cart uses a different SKU or price field than the listing; 'out of stock' branch that always offers a dearer substitute); deal price only applied to a list the user cannot actually reach.
compliant: The item and price the user clicked are what reaches the cart and payment; unavailability is shown before the user commits, without auto-substituting a dearer product.
notApplicableWhen: Platform has no advertised offers, listings or deals.

title: No drip pricing: the full price is shown upfront
source: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 item 8 (Drip Pricing), (i) to (iv)
violation: Mandatory fees (platform, convenience, handling, service, packaging) added only at a late checkout or payment step; payable amount at payment > price first shown; product or app marketed as 'free' when continued use requires a purchase; a paid service blocked until an extra purchase.
compliant: Listing and product pages show the price including all non-optional fees, or show every fee at the first price display; the total never rises between steps except for options the user picked; 'free' claims disclose any paid continuation.
notApplicableWhen: Platform takes no payments and shows no prices.

title: Advertising is not disguised as other content
source: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 item 9 (Disguised Advertisement); CCPA Misleading Advertisements Guidelines, 2022
violation: Paid placements, affiliate posts, influencer content or promoted 'reviews'/'top picks'/'editor's choice' rendered with the same component as organic content and no 'Ad'/'Sponsored'/'Paid partnership' label (e.g. isSponsored flag in data but not rendered).
compliant: Every paid or promoted item renders a visible, persistent disclosure label next to it.
notApplicableWhen: Platform shows no paid, promoted, affiliate or influencer content.

title: No nagging
source: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 item 10 (Nagging)
violation: Upsell, app-download, notification or sign-up prompts re-shown on every page/step or on a short interval, with no persistent 'don't show again' (dismissal not stored, or prompt reopens on route change).
compliant: Prompts are shown once or rarely, respect a stored dismissal, and do not block the task.
notApplicableWhen: Platform has no promotional prompts or interstitials.

title: No trick questions or confusing wording
source: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 item 11 (Trick Question)
violation: Double negatives or inverted checkbox semantics ('Uncheck to not stop receiving offers', 'Don't not send me updates'); a checkbox whose checked state means opt-out while siblings mean opt-in; button labels that do not match the action.
compliant: Each control states one plain action in positive wording; checked always means 'yes, do this'.
notApplicableWhen: Platform has no questions, checkboxes or choice prompts.

title: No surreptitious SaaS billing
source: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 item 12 (SaaS Billing)
violation: Free trial auto-converts to paid with no disclosure of date and amount at sign-up and no reminder logic; renewal price/frequency absent from the plan screen; plan upgrades or seat increases charged without a confirm step; no pre-renewal email/notification job in the code.
compliant: Trial sign-up shows the conversion date, amount and billing period next to the confirm button; code sends a reminder before the first charge and each renewal; upgrades require explicit confirmation.
notApplicableWhen: Platform has no recurring billing, trials or auto-renewals.

title: No rogue malware or scareware
source: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023, Annexure 1 item 13 (Rogue Malwares)
violation: Fake 'virus detected' / 'device at risk' / 'phone slow' alerts or scans not backed by any real detection logic, linked to a purchase; code that downloads or installs unrequested executables.
compliant: Security warnings only come from real detection results and never gate a sale; no unrequested downloads.
notApplicableWhen: Platform sells no security, cleaning or device-performance products and shows no device alerts.

title: 'Free' claims disclose every condition
source: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 s.2(28) (misleading advertisement); CCPA Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements, 2022 (free claims); PhysicsWallah order (PIB, 3 Jun 2026)
violation: Copy says 'Free', 'Rs 0', 'free trial' or 'free course' while code requires payment details, registration or a purchase to access, with no adjacent disclosure of the condition.
compliant: Any condition (registration, card, later charge, minimum purchase) is stated next to the 'free' claim in the same view.
notApplicableWhen: Platform makes no 'free' claims.

title: Purchase consent only by explicit affirmative action; no pre-ticked boxes
source: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, Rule 4(9)
violation: Any checkbox, toggle or radio that records agreement to buy/add/pay (add-on, insurance, donation, auto-renew, T&C bundled with purchase) is pre-selected (checked, defaultChecked, value=true default, initial state true), or consent is inferred from scrolling/continuing.
compliant: All purchase-related consent controls default to unselected/false and require a click; consent is stored only after that action.
notApplicableWhen: Platform sells nothing (no checkout).

title: Entity identity, customer care and grievance officer shown on the platform
source: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, Rule 4(2) and 4(4); Rule 6(5)(e) for sellers; DPDP Act s.6(3) contact person (data requests)
violation: No page/footer/component renders the legal entity name, HQ address, customer-care contacts, and the grievance officer's name, designation and contact (grep finds no 'Grievance Officer' copy).
compliant: Footer or a linked 'Contact / Grievance Redressal' page renders legal name, address, customer-care email/phone, and grievance officer name, designation and contact; a data-protection contact is also listed.
notApplicableWhen: Not an e-commerce entity (no buying or selling of goods or services).

title: Total price in a single figure with a breakup of all charges
source: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, Rule 6(5)(b) (marketplace sellers) and Rule 7(1)(e) (inventory entities); Rule 5(3)(e)
violation: Order summary shows only a total, or only item prices, without line items for delivery, handling, convenience, platform fees and tax; breakup components do not sum to the total.
compliant: Before payment the summary shows each compulsory and voluntary charge and tax, plus one total that equals their sum.
notApplicableWhen: Platform takes no payments.

title: Return, refund, exchange, warranty, delivery and payment info shown pre-purchase
source: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, Rule 5(3)(c), 6(5)(g)-(i), 7(1)(a); best-before date added by E-Commerce (Amendment) Rules, 2026 from 1 Jan 2027
violation: Product/checkout pages have no return/refund/exchange policy, delivery estimate, return-shipping cost or warranty info, and no link to such a policy; policy page missing from routes.
compliant: Product page or checkout shows or links the return/refund/exchange, warranty, delivery and return-shipping-cost terms (and best-before date where relevant).
notApplicableWhen: Platform sells only intangible services where returns do not apply and states so; still check refund terms.

title: Payment methods, fees and how to cancel regular payments disclosed
source: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, Rule 5(3)(d) and Rule 7(1)(c)
violation: Recurring/auto-pay checkout gives no text on fees for each payment method or on the procedure to cancel regular payments; no help/FAQ copy on stopping auto-debit.
compliant: Checkout or a linked page lists payment methods, any method-specific fees, charge-back options, and step-by-step instructions to cancel regular payments.
notApplicableWhen: Platform has no recurring payments and charges no payment-method fees.

title: Seller details shown on marketplace listings
source: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, Rule 5(3)(a); seller website/email added by 2026 Amendment from 1 Jan 2027
violation: Marketplace product page renders no seller name, address, customer-care number or rating (seller field fetched but not displayed).
compliant: Listing or a seller link shows business name, address, customer-care number, rating and (from 2027) website/email where available.
notApplicableWhen: Inventory model (the platform is the only seller).

title: Importer and country of origin shown for imported goods
source: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, Rule 4(6) and 6(5)(d),(f); Rule 4(6)(b) as amended 2026 (from 1 Jan 2027)
violation: Product schema has no country-of-origin/importer fields, or they exist but are not rendered on the product page for imported goods.
compliant: Product page renders country of origin (full name) and importer name/details for imported goods.
notApplicableWhen: Platform sells no physical goods, or only domestic goods.

title: No price discrimination between consumers of the same class
source: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, Rule 4(11)(a)-(b); CCPA notices to Ola/Uber on device-based fares (Jan 2025)
violation: Pricing logic branches on device OS, user agent, battery level, app platform (iOS vs Android) or similar arbitrary attributes to change the fare/price for the same item, time and location.
compliant: Price depends only on disclosed product/service factors (item, quantity, location, time, declared surge rules); no OS/device/user-agent inputs in price calculation.
notApplicableWhen: Platform has fixed list prices with no per-user price computation.

title: Ranking parameters disclosed; search not manipulated
source: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, Rule 5(3)(f) (descending order from 2027) and Rule 4(11)(c) inserted by 2026 Amendment (from 1 Jan 2027)
violation: No page explains the main ranking parameters; search code boosts own-brand or paying sellers without disclosure, or injects results unrelated to the query.
compliant: A plain-language page lists the main ranking parameters in descending order of importance; search ranking code matches that description.
notApplicableWhen: Platform has no search, listings or rankings of multiple goods or sellers.

title: Sponsored listings distinctly and prominently labelled
source: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules, 2026, new Rule 4(12) (notified 9 Sep 2026, in force 1 Jan 2027)
violation: Search/listing cards for promoted items render no 'Sponsored'/'Ad' badge, or the badge is tiny, low-contrast, or only in alt text/tooltip.
compliant: Every sponsored card shows a visible 'Sponsored' label at readable size, rendered from the same flag that drives the paid boost.
notApplicableWhen: Platform sells no paid placements.

title: Discounts show the prior price (lowest in the previous 30 days)
source: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules, 2026, new Rule 4(13) (in force 1 Jan 2027)
violation: Strike-through/MRP/'was' price or '% off' computed from a static compare-at/list field, not from a 30-day price history; no price-history store at all while discounts are shown.
compliant: When a reduction is announced, the displayed prior price is the minimum price in the preceding 30 days from stored price history, shown next to the reduced price.
notApplicableWhen: Platform never shows discounts or reduced prices.

title: Dark-pattern self-audit certificate displayed
source: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules, 2026, new Rule 4(15) (in force 1 Jan 2027); CCPA advisory of 5 Jun 2025
violation: No page, footer link or asset showing a dark-pattern self-audit certificate/declaration.
compliant: Footer or compliance page prominently links a current yearly self-audit certificate.
notApplicableWhen: Not an e-commerce entity.

title: No bundled fees for unrelated services
source: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules, 2026, new Rule 5(7) (in force 1 Jan 2027); exception for loyalty/membership programmes
violation: A single platform/convenience fee line whose definition or comments combine unrelated services (e.g. insurance, donation, third-party subscription) with platform service.
compliant: Fees cover only platform services; unrelated services are separate, optional lines, or part of an opted-in loyalty/membership plan.
notApplicableWhen: Not a marketplace e-commerce entity, or no platform fees.

title: Consent requests come with a clear, standalone notice
source: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 s.5(1) and s.6(3); DPDP Rules, 2025 Rule 3 (in force 18 months after 14 Nov 2025)
violation: Data collection forms or consent prompts with no notice text, or a notice that only links a long privacy policy; notice lacks an itemised list of data, the purposes, how to withdraw, and how to complain to the Data Protection Board; no language option.
compliant: Before or with the consent request, a standalone plain-language notice itemises data and purposes and links withdrawal, rights and complaint routes; English or an Eighth Schedule language can be selected.
notApplicableWhen: Platform collects no personal data on consent (e.g. only legitimate-use processing).

title: Data consent by clear affirmative action; no pre-ticked consent
source: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 s.6(1)
violation: Marketing, tracking, data-sharing or cookie consent toggles default to on (checked, defaultChecked, useState(true), consent=true default); consent assumed from use/scroll; 'Accept' only, no reject.
compliant: Each consent defaults off and is recorded only after an affirmative click; a reject option sits alongside accept.
notApplicableWhen: Platform collects no personal data by consent.

title: Consent is specific, unbundled and not a condition for unnecessary data
source: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 s.6(1) (free, specific, unconditional; limited to necessary data) and its telemedicine illustration
violation: One checkbox/button covers service terms + marketing + third-party sharing; service blocked unless the user grants unrelated permissions (contacts, location, marketing) not needed for the feature.
compliant: Separate consent per purpose; optional purposes can be refused while the core service still works; permissions are requested only when the feature needs them.
notApplicableWhen: Platform collects no personal data by consent.

title: Withdrawing consent is as easy as giving it
source: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 s.6(4); DPDP Rules, 2025 Rule 3(c)(i)
violation: Consent given with one click at sign-up but no settings toggle to withdraw; withdrawal only by email/support ticket; unsubscribe link missing in marketing templates.
compliant: Privacy/consent settings expose a toggle per purpose; marketing messages include one-click unsubscribe; withdrawal takes no more steps than granting.
notApplicableWhen: Platform collects no personal data by consent.

title: Children: verifiable parental consent; no tracking or targeted ads
source: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 s.9(1) and 9(3); DPDP Rules, 2025 Rule 10
violation: Service aimed at or used by under-18s (ed-tech, games) with no age gate or parental-consent flow; analytics/ad SDKs and behavioural targeting active for users flagged or likely to be children.
compliant: Age declaration plus a verifiable parental-consent step before processing child data; ad targeting and behavioural tracking disabled for child accounts.
notApplicableWhen: Platform is clearly not directed at children and blocks under-18 sign-ups.

title: Recurring payments set up only through a disclosed, authenticated mandate
source: RBI Digital Payments - E-mandate Framework, 2026 (21 Apr 2026), paras 4(a)-(c), 5(a), 8 (issuer/acquirer duties; acquirers must ensure merchant compliance, para 10(c))
violation: Card/UPI is stored and charged on a schedule by the merchant's own cron/job without registering an e-mandate via the payment gateway's mandate/subscription API; mandate screen omits amount (or max amount), frequency and validity; first charge processed outside the AFA flow.
compliant: Recurring charges use the gateway's e-mandate/subscription API (with AFA at registration and first debit); checkout shows amount or cap, frequency, start date and validity before the user authorises.
notApplicableWhen: Platform takes no recurring or auto-debit payments.

title: Users can see and withdraw a mandate; renewal is notified
source: RBI Digital Payments - E-mandate Framework, 2026 (21 Apr 2026), paras 4(b) (withdraw at any time, communicated at registration), 6 (24-hour pre-debit notification and opt-out)
violation: No in-app view of active auto-pay with a cancel/revoke action; registration screen does not say the mandate can be withdrawn; merchant-side code suppresses or replaces gateway pre-debit notifications or schedules charges with no advance notice.
compliant: Account page lists active mandates with a working revoke/cancel call to the gateway; registration copy explains withdrawal; renewal reminders are sent ahead of each debit.
notApplicableWhen: Platform takes no recurring or auto-debit payments.

title: Tips only after the service; no pay-more prompts during booking
source: Motor Vehicle Aggregator Guidelines, 2025 (tipping only after ride, as cited by CCPA); CCPA Rapido order (PIB, 15 Sep 2026)
violation: Tip/'add +₹10' prompts shown at booking or while searching for a driver; copy implying higher payment means faster pickup without data; price sliders coloured to push upward.
compliant: Tip option appears only after the ride/service ends, is optional, with neutral copy and no default amount.
notApplicableWhen: Not a ride-hailing, delivery or other service platform with tipping.

title: Advertised and listed prices include non-optional fees
source: ASCI Guidelines for Online Deceptive Design Patterns in Advertising (15 Jun 2023, applicable from 1 Sep 2023), Guideline 1 (Drip Pricing)
violation: Listing cards, banners or ad creatives show a base price while taxes or fees paid by all or most buyers are added later.
compliant: Listing/ad price includes taxes and fees that apply to all or most buyers.
notApplicableWhen: Platform shows no prices in listings or ads.

title: Ad symbols keep their usual meaning (X closes)
source: ASCI Guidelines for Online Deceptive Design Patterns in Advertising (15 Jun 2023, applicable from 1 Sep 2023), Guideline 2 (Bait and Switch), example (c)
violation: Ad or promo overlay where the X/close element's handler opens the advertiser, installs or navigates instead of dismissing.
compliant: Close controls in ads only dismiss the ad.
notApplicableWhen: Platform shows no ads or promotional overlays.

title: Influencer, paid-review and editorial-style ads are labelled
source: ASCI Guidelines for Online Deceptive Design Patterns in Advertising (15 Jun 2023, applicable from 1 Sep 2023), Guideline 4 (Disguised Ads; numbered DD-3 here because ASCI Guideline 3 is folded into CCPA-DP-01); ASCI influencer advertising guidelines
violation: Influencer posts, paid reviews or advertorial blocks rendered without an 'Ad'/'Sponsored'/'Paid partnership' label.
compliant: Such content shows an upfront, prominent disclosure label.
notApplicableWhen: No influencer, paid-review or advertorial content.

title: Mandatory packaged-commodity declarations shown on product pages
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(10) (inserted 2017, effective 1 Jan 2018) read with Rule 6(1)
violation: Product page/schema for pre-packaged goods lacks or does not render MRP (inclusive of taxes), net quantity, unit sale price, manufacturer/packer/importer name and address, country of origin, consumer-care details, or generic name.
compliant: Product page renders all Rule 6(1) declarations (MRP, net quantity, unit sale price, maker/packer/importer, country of origin, consumer care, generic name); manufacturing date/best-before shown where applicable.
notApplicableWhen: Platform sells no pre-packaged goods (services, digital goods only).

title: Searchable, sortable country-of-origin filter for imported goods
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2026, G.S.R. 128(E) of 13 Feb 2026, new Rule 6(10A) (reported in force 1 Jul 2026)
violation: Catalogue search/filter code offers no country-of-origin facet or sort although imported packaged goods are sold.
compliant: Search UI exposes a country-of-origin filter and sort backed by the product's origin field.
notApplicableWhen: No imported pre-packaged goods sold.
